tagline: The future of real estate is here
hero_kpi_rationale: No distinctive wow factor identified. Revenue is the primary performance indicator in the proptech sector, reflecting growth in transaction volume and platform adoption.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Money earned by the company through its real estate technology services.
kpis.description: Revenue advances through increased transaction volume and geographic expansion.
kpis.signal: Moderate growth despite a tight real estate market.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of services, expressed as a percentage.
kpis.description: Gross margin improves through better automation and economies of scale.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Profit before taxes relative to total revenue.
kpis.description: Operating margin increases despite sustained investments in technology.

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Share of revenue used to develop new technology features.
kpis.description: The company maintains a stable level of R&D investment to enhance its platform.

kpis.name: Headcount (employees)
kpis.explanation: Total number of people employed by the company.
kpis.description: The company made workforce adjustments to optimize operating costs.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on physical or digital assets intended to enhance the platform.
kpis.description: CAPEX increases to strengthen digital capabilities and security.
